title: Step 2 - Mastering Kernel SVM: Improving Accuracy with Non-Linear Classifiers

cues.en: Instructor: Run all, this will run all the sales, including this one which will get us the new model with the new non-linear kernel.
cues.zh: 選 Run all 就會執行所有儲存格，包括這個，產生使用新非線性核心的新模型。

cues.en: Where is it? Right here, kernel equals rbf.
cues.zh: 它在哪裡？就在這裡，kernel 等於 rbf。

cues.en: And so now, now it's very interesting, because this time, we have a non-linear classifier.
cues.zh: 現在很有意思，因為這次是非線性分類器。

cues.en: And therefore, I look forward to showing you the visualization results at the end, you know, both for the training set and test set, because you will see that we will get a super beautiful curve
cues.zh: 所以很期待展示最後的視覺化結果，包括訓練集與測試集，因為你會看到非常漂亮的曲線，

cues.en: that will catch the right observation points, you know, the right red customers in the right red region and the right green customers in the right green prediction region.
cues.zh: 把正確的觀測點，紅色顧客放在正確的紅色區域，綠色顧客放在正確的綠色預測區域。

cues.en: Not all of them of course, but the ones which couldn't get cut properly by the previous, you know, linear model, such as the support vector machine or the logistic regression model, right?
cues.zh: 當然不是全部，而是先前線性模型無法妥善劃分的那些，像支援向量機或邏輯斯迴歸，對吧？

cues.en: Remember this straight line?
cues.zh: 記得那條直線嗎？

cues.en: This straight line could not catch these customer properly in the right green region and these ones as well.
cues.zh: 那條直線無法把這些顧客妥善放進正確的綠色區域，這些也是。

cues.en: And so you will see that now we will get much better results.
cues.zh: 所以你會看到現在的結果好得多。

cues.en: But first, because you know, right now, I think it should be, you know, loading, running the code.
cues.zh: 不過先看別的，因為我想現在應該還在載入、執行程式碼。

cues.en: Yes. So we don't have yet the final result. But that's okay.
cues.zh: 是的，還沒有最終結果。不過沒關係。

cues.en: Let's observe, you know, the different predictions.
cues.zh: 先觀察不同的預測。

cues.en: So first, our kernel svm was perfectly able to predict the right result here.
cues.zh: 首先，核心 SVM 在這裡能完全正確地預測結果。

cues.en: Remember with that customer of age 30 and estimated salary $87,000 who in reality didn't buy indeed any SUV?
cues.zh: 記得那位年齡 30、預估薪資 87,000 美元、實際沒有購買 SUV 的顧客嗎？

cues.en: And here we get the same prediction.
cues.zh: 這裡得到相同預測。

cues.en: So that's all good.
cues.zh: 所以一切正常。

cues.en: Then let's look at the test set results.
cues.zh: 接著看測試集結果。

cues.en: All right. So let's crawl back up a bit.
cues.zh: 好，往上捲一點。

cues.en: So that's the test set result.
cues.zh: 這是測試集結果。

cues.en: And well, once again, we have many correct predictions and incorrect one here.
cues.zh: 再次看到有很多正確預測，這裡則有一筆錯誤。

cues.en: The real result is zero, meaning that in reality, this particular customer didn't buy the SUV.
cues.zh: 真實結果是 0，代表這位顧客實際上沒有購買 SUV。

cues.en: But our model predicted that this customer bought the SUV.
cues.zh: 但模型預測這位顧客有購買 SUV。

cues.en: Then we have the same incorrect prediction here.
cues.zh: 這裡也有同樣的錯誤預測。

cues.en: Then all correct, all correct.
cues.zh: 接著都正確，都正確。

cues.en: It looks very good.
cues.zh: 看起來很好。

cues.en: Here we have an incorrect prediction, the inverse one.
cues.zh: 這裡有一筆相反的錯誤預測。

cues.en: In reality, the customer bought the SUV, but our model predicted that the customer didn't buy the SUV.
cues.zh: 顧客實際購買了 SUV，但模型預測他沒有購買。

cues.en: Then all correct, all correct, all correct.
cues.zh: 接著都正確，都正確，都正確。

cues.en: It looks very, very, very good, right?
cues.zh: 看起來非常非常好，對吧？

cues.en: I really wonder if we can beat this accuracy.
cues.zh: 我真的很想知道能否超越之前的準確率。

cues.en: And that's what we're about to find out right now with, you know, the confusion matrix.
cues.zh: 現在就要用混淆矩陣找出答案。

cues.en: Are you ready? Are we gonna beat the so far best accuracy we got, which was, I remind 93%, from the k nearest neighbor model.
cues.zh: 準備好了嗎？能否超越目前最佳準確率？提醒一下，K 最近鄰模型得到的是 93%。

cues.en: Here it is, 93%.
And now let's see if we managed to beat it.
cues.zh: 看看是否成功超越。

cues.en: All right, let's scroll down.
cues.zh: 好，往下捲。

cues.en: And the accuracy is 93% again.
cues.zh: 準確率又是 93%。

cues.en: Okay, so we didn't beat it, but we reached the same level as the k and n.
cues.zh: 好，所以沒有超越，但達到與 KNN 相同的水準。

cues.en: And now let's see if we get the curve.
cues.zh: 現在看看曲線出來了沒有。

cues.en: No, still not.
cues.zh: 還沒有。

cues.en: All right, you know, it's still running.
cues.zh: 好，仍在執行。

cues.en: That's because we have a small step here, 0.25.
cues.zh: 因為這裡的步長很小，只有 0.25。

cues.en: If you want this to run faster, you can actually increase the step to 0.5 or even 1.
cues.zh: 如果想快一點，可以把步長提高到 0.5，甚至 1。

cues.en: But you'll get a less smooth curve, you know, less nice curve.
cues.zh: 不過曲線會比較不平滑、比較不好看。

cues.en: But that's okay.
cues.zh: 但沒關係。

cues.en: So you know, just in case it will get us the results in a few minutes or too long time, well, let's maybe have a look at them in the original implementation which is right here. Okay?
cues.zh: 萬一還要好幾分鐘，或花太久時間，我們先在這裡的原始實作中查看結果，好嗎？

cues.en: Just let's do that.
cues.zh: 就這麼做。

cues.en: Let's observe the final results.
cues.zh: 觀察最終結果。

cues.en: And here they are.
cues.zh: 結果在這裡。

cues.en: As you can see, we get a super nice prediction boundary curve that catches, this time, perfectly well, those green customers who couldn't get cut properly
cues.zh: 可以看到非常漂亮的預測邊界曲線，這次能很好地涵蓋那些先前無法被線性分類器妥善劃分的綠色顧客，

cues.en: by the linear classifiers, you know, with the straight line.
cues.zh: 也就是先前那條直線處理不好的顧客。

cues.en: This time, it is catching them perfectly well, except these ones of course, because they're trapped in the middle of many red customers.
cues.zh: 這次能妥善涵蓋，當然除了這些，因為他們被許多紅色顧客包圍。

cues.en: But you know, these ones which couldn't be cut properly by the logistic regression model, or you know, the svm classifier, right?
cues.zh: 不過那些先前邏輯斯迴歸模型，或 SVM 分類器無法妥善劃分的顧客，對吧？

cues.en: If we have to look at it again, remember that the customers here couldn't get cut properly because of that straight line.
cues.zh: 再看一次，記得這裡的顧客因為那條直線，無法被妥善劃分。

cues.en: But now that we have a curve.
cues.zh: 但現在有了曲線。

cues.en: Oh, there we go, we have the results.
cues.zh: 喔，好了，結果出來了。

cues.en: Now that we have this curve, well, these same customers, you know, these are exactly the same one, these same customers are now cut properly in the green region.
cues.zh: 現在有這條曲線，相同的顧客，完全相同的這些顧客，就能妥善落在綠色區域。

cues.en: And same for these ones actually, you know?
cues.zh: 這些也是。

cues.en: These ones are cut in right green region by very short.
cues.zh: 這些也以非常小的差距被劃進正確綠色區域。

cues.en: And same for these ones.
cues.zh: 這些也一樣。

cues.en: And here, you know, these ones are incorrect predictions.
cues.zh: 這裡這些則是錯誤預測。

cues.en: But once again that's totally fine.
cues.zh: 不過再次強調，完全沒問題。

cues.en: We want to avoid over-fitting anyway, because indeed, what's mostly important are the results of the test set, which we still don't have, it is still running.
cues.zh: 反正也要避免過度擬合，因為最重要的是測試集結果。現在還沒出來，仍在執行。

cues.en: But we should get them in a second.
cues.zh: 不過應該很快就會得到。

cues.en: Or you know, let's just have a look at them right here.
cues.zh: 或者直接來這裡看。

cues.en: So now the challenge is to see whether we have the same results on new observations, meaning on observations with which arm wasn't trained.
cues.zh: 現在的挑戰是，新觀測值，也就是模型沒有用來訓練的觀測值，能否得到同樣好的結果。

cues.en: And that's exactly the observations that test set, you know, the 100 customers of the test set.
cues.zh: 那正是測試集的觀測值，也就是測試集中的 100 位顧客。

cues.en: And well, wow, here now, it looks even better, which makes sense, right, because we had 93% accuracy.
cues.zh: 哇，現在看起來更好，這很合理，對吧？因為準確率是 93%。

cues.en: And since they are 100 customers in a test set, we actually have 93 correct predictions and seven incorrect predictions.
cues.zh: 既然測試集有 100 位顧客，就代表 93 筆正確預測與 7 筆錯誤預測。

cues.en: And we can actually count them here, you know, the seven incorrect predictions.
cues.zh: 這裡實際可以數出那七筆錯誤。

cues.en: We have the two first ones here, the red customers falling in the wrong green prediction region, then these two here, two other red customers falling in the wrong green prediction regions,
cues.zh: 前兩筆在這裡，是落在錯誤綠色預測區域的紅色顧客；這裡又有兩位紅色顧客落在錯誤的綠色預測區域，

cues.en: and then these three green customers falling in the wrong red prediction region.
cues.zh: 接著是這三位綠色顧客，落在錯誤的紅色預測區域。

cues.en: But that's totally fine.
cues.zh: 但完全沒問題。

cues.en: Once again, thanks to this beautiful curve here, we managed to catch these customers in the right region, which couldn't be the case previously because of the straight line resulting from the linear classifier.
cues.zh: 再次因為這條漂亮曲線，成功把這些顧客放進正確區域，先前線性分類器產生直線時做不到。

cues.en: But this time, there we go, we have a non-linear classifier which is the reason why we have this curve, and that's why we get a better accuracy.
cues.zh: 這次有了非線性分類器，因此出現這條曲線，也因此得到更好的準確率。

cues.en: All right. So I'm, at the same time, very happy and excited, because this curve is beautiful, and we got great results.
cues.zh: 好，我同時很開心也很興奮，因為曲線很漂亮，結果也很棒。

cues.en: But I'm still hoping that with a future classification model like the three ones we have let, we can beat that 93% accuracy
cues.zh: 不過仍希望接下來剩下的三種分類模型，能超越這個 93% 準確率，

cues.en: which we got so far as the best ones by two models, the k nearest neighbors and the kernel svm.
cues.zh: 目前兩個模型得到同樣的最佳結果，也就是 K 最近鄰與核心 SVM。

cues.en: So I look forward to seeing you in this next practical activity.
cues.zh: 期待在下一個實作活動見到你。

cues.en: And until then, enjoy machine learning.
cues.zh: 在此之前，享受機器學習吧。
